reference.title: A Fourth-Order Runge-Kutta in the Interaction Picture Method for Supercontinuum Generation in Optical Fibers
reference.author: Johan Hult

soliton_deck.P0_formula: P0 = N^2 |beta2| / (gamma T0^2), N = 2, paper prints 1.24 kW
soliton_deck.metric: average relative intensity error epsilon (paper Eq. 13) after one soliton period; A_true = the input envelope (exact recurrence)

anchors.fit_window: log-log slope over the pre-floor band

scg_deck.source: paper Sec. III.B (from Dudley and Coen), Table I, p. 3773
scg_deck.raman_response: paper: Hollenbeck-Cantrell modal sum [Hult ref 21]; house engine: two-exponential Blow-Wood tau1 = 12.2 fs / tau2 = 32 fs — RECORDED DEVIATION
scg_deck.shock: first-order (1 + (i/omega0) d/dT) as in paper Eq. (2)

anchors.fission: the N-soliton fissions into fundamental solitons (multiple temporal peaks at exit)
anchors.redshift: Raman self-frequency shift of ejected solitons to longer wavelengths
anchors.DW: dispersive-wave spectral components on the short-wavelength side (Fig. 2a/b morphology)
anchors.floor: epsilon ~ 1e-6..1e-8 band at the finest coarseness of the ladder (paper Fig. 3 floor ~1e-8 at Nsteps ~ 3e4)

runtime.soliton_ladder: 6 runs x (<= 640 steps x 4096 pts) ~ seconds
runtime.scg_ladder: coarse ladder <= 4096 steps + one fine reference run (~40-90 s total)
